brief: Prioritise this ageing unit for pre-event attention ahead of younger units in similar condition because it has a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. If this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. For events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
